children: Eliecer Viamontes, Insider, reported a sale of Entergy common stock on September 14, 2026. The shares were sold at a weighted average price of $103.93 per share. The total reported sale amount was $942,437. Following the transaction, Viamontes directly owns 9,320 shares and indirectly owns 2,618 shares. The report states the shares were sold in multiple transactions ranging from $103.90 to $103.96 and that additional ownership totals reflect dividend reinvestment and a spouse-to-joint-account transfer.
